kind: one-shot synthetic construction boundary; no live allocation

motivating_evidence.observation: The retained triage associates a surrounding decision window with sampled health falling 100 to 84 during a slow answer/cover interval; exact damage timing is unresolved.

hypothesis: V39 computes the authored health floor as max(critical_health_minimum, source_health - maximum_health_loss); a typed health value of 84 from source 100 will invalidate only when it is below that floor.
test: Exercise the current-main build_cover_monitor and paired health/ammo observer with maximum_health_loss values 0 through 20, and at each setting probe health 84, the exact derived floor, and one point below the floor.
decision: Construction passes only if the real source path agrees at every point with strict-below threshold semantics and never grants input authority. This can show the configured guard boundary, not live timing or policy efficacy.
counterhypothesis: The authored validity floor may not interrupt at the expected point due to pair binding, event ordering, threshold comparison, or controller integration behavior.
uncertainty: Synthetic typed observations do not establish threat classification, damage timing, when a real HUD value becomes available, interruption latency, key release, useful feedback, recovery, survival, or task effect.
retry_policy: Run the packaged candidate once after this freeze. Do not run a game/model allocation or repeat the candidate to seek a preferred result.
